overrides.list_console_messages: Console messages with source-mapped stacks. This is the 'why did it break' list.
overrides.get_console_message: One console message in full, by its msgid.
overrides.list_network_requests: Every request since load with status and timing.
overrides.get_network_request: One request or response in full: headers, cookies, body.
overrides.emulate: Throttle CPU/network, set geolocation, user agent, viewport, colour scheme or extra headers.
overrides.performance_start_trace: Record a performance trace (LCP/INP/CLS, insights). Reload first if you want a cold load.
overrides.performance_stop_trace: Stop the trace and keep the raw file.
overrides.performance_analyze_insight: Explain one insight from the last trace.
overrides.lighthouse_audit: Lighthouse scores and reports for accessibility, SEO, best practices and agentic browsing.
overrides.take_heapsnapshot: Heap snapshot of the page for memory analysis.
